fact: As reported to the planning minister on figures to the end of June 2025, service sites in 380 technology centres in local administration had been developed, 316 in cities and districts, 30 in rural units and 34 in new city authorities, where requests are sent through a system to back-end departments and linked with participating government bodies.
title: Minister of Planning, Economic Development, and International Cooperation Receives Report on Implementation Status of Information Infrastructure Center Projects
publisher: Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation
